idea.body: Metric units all connect by a power of ten: 100 centimeters make a meter, 1000 grams make a kilogram, 1000 milliliters make a liter. To turn a bigger unit into a smaller one, multiply by that number. To turn a smaller unit into a bigger one, divide by it instead. Two measurements can only be added or compared once they share the same unit, so convert first, then combine. A wire measuring 2 meters and 35 centimeters is 235 centimeters in total, since 2 meters is 200 centimeters plus the extra 35.

workedExample.prompt: A rope measures 3 meters and 40 centimeters. What is that in centimeters, altogether?
steps: 3 meters is 3 times 100, which is 300 centimeters.
Add the extra 40 centimeters: 300 plus 40 is 340.

ways.name: Convert to the smaller unit
ways.when: Use this when a problem asks for a total in the smaller unit.
steps: Find how many of the smaller unit make one of the bigger unit.
Multiply the bigger unit's amount by that number.
Add on any amount already given in the smaller unit.
ways.trap: Adding the two numbers directly, like 3 plus 40, without converting the meters first.

ways.name: Convert to the bigger unit
ways.when: Use this when a problem asks for a total in the bigger unit instead.
steps: Find how many of the smaller unit make one of the bigger unit.
Divide the total smaller-unit amount by that number.
Write the whole number part as the bigger unit and the remainder as what is left over.
ways.trap: Forgetting to keep the remainder as the leftover smaller unit, and dropping it entirely.

ways.name: Shift like a decimal
ways.when: Use this when converting between units that differ by a power of ten, like grams and kilograms.
steps: Write the amount as a decimal number of the bigger unit.
Moving to a smaller unit shifts the decimal point right, one place for each zero in the conversion number.
Moving to a bigger unit shifts the decimal point left instead.
ways.trap: Shifting the decimal point the wrong number of places, off by a factor of ten.

ways.name: Match units before combining
ways.when: Use this when two measurements in different units must be added or compared.
steps: Pick one unit for both measurements, usually the smaller one.
Convert every measurement into that one unit.
Add or compare the converted numbers.
ways.trap: Adding the raw numbers, like 120 plus 65, before converting the meters part into centimeters.
